scope: Public aerial LiDAR noise-label candidates, with nine calibration/demo tiles only. Not dust/sunlight ground truth or Ouster sensor calibration.

sources.name: ECLAIR
sources.meaning: Sporadic airborne or underground noise points; physical cause unspecified.
sources.quality: All labels initially automatic. Ground/Vegetation/Unassigned/Noise excluded from per-class misclassification threshold used to designate GT vs pseudo tiles. GT designation does not certify Noise quality.
sources.license: Dataset CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; repository MIT is not the data license. Commercial use requires separate arrangement.
sources.access: Form with email/name/institution/purpose; no request sent and no point data acquired.
sources.use: Candidate for general anomaly and thin-wire preservation review after access/license/label QA; not weather synthesis.

sources.name: TS40K
sources.meaning: Noise in UAV power-infrastructure scenes; physical cause unspecified.
sources.quality: Paper acknowledges mislabeled noise, power lines, ground and towers. Check model ignore-index and class remapping before using pretrained outputs.
sources.license: Academic research only; commercial use requires prior owner consent.
sources.access: Institutional-email request to data owners; no message sent and no point data acquired.
sources.use: Candidate for distinguishing anomalous points from wires/towers, not a dust or sunlight label set.

sources.name: B4 · San Andreas / San Jacinto
sources.citation: Bevis, M. and Hudnut, K. (2005), B4 Lidar Project. NCALM, USGS, Ohio State University, Southern California Integrated GPS Project; classified reprocessing by Stephen B. DeLong, USGS. Distributed by OpenTopography.
sources.meaning: Low Point (low noise), not a physical-cause label.
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 per OpenTopography metadata; acknowledge data providers and OpenTopography.
sources.crs: WGS84 / UTM 11N EPSG:32611; ellipsoid heights; meters.
sources.access: Official anonymous S3 pc-bulk/CA05USGSB4; three metadata-selected calibration/demo tiles.
sources.use: Separate aerial general-anomaly reference; preserve original classifications, context and LAS fields.

integration_policy.evaluation_note: Compare by source/capture/region with spatial buffers and source-level holdout when designing a future benchmark; not random point splits. No model result is reported here.
